verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage's own docs say customers can be screened against Politically Exposed Persons registers (PEPs) within its global screening database, so PEP identification is a documented first-party capability. Nothing in the evidence covers detecting relatives or close associates of PEPs, or surfacing source context such as PEP positions, source documents or citations on a hit. missing for 10: related/close-associate (RCA) identification, supporting source context on PEP matches, detailed PEP data documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
